title: Figures 89-90: Right circular cylinder CFD pressure and temperature at 100 mph
description: First page of "ATTACHMENT III - RIGHT CIRCULAR CYLINDER CFD CONTOUR PLOTS FOR PRESSURE, TEMPERATURE AND MACH NUMBER," showing two color contour plots of a flat-ended cylinder at 1/6 scale with numeric legends. Captions read "Figure 89. Cylinder Pressure at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 100 mph with Subsonic Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (high pressure on the front face, in Pa) and "Figure 90. Cylinder Temperature at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 100 mph with Subsonic Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" (warm wake band, in K). Page 128 of the BAASS UAP Analysis Capabilities report.
